name: list_apps
description: List every app registered in the tower with its status (running/available).

name: app_status
description: Get status and details of one registered app.

name: tower_status
description: Health of all AI engines and cloud keys: ollama, localai, needle, providers.

name: search_web
description: Search the web (DuckDuckGo) and get top results with titles and URLs.

name: search_skills
description: Search VRTX-BRAIN's skills library (580+ how-to skills: dev, game-dev, 3D/CAD, security, media, business, writing...). Use before doing any specialized task to find an existing playbook.

name: read_skill
description: Load the full instructions of a skill by its name (from search_skills). Returns the SKILL.md playbook.

name: list_rules
description: List VRTX-BRAIN's brain rules (the constitution you operate under): id, kind, gate_mode and one-line statement. hard = must obey.

name: read_rule
description: Read one brain rule in full by number or id (e.g. '2' or '002-secrets').

name: http_get
description: Fetch a URL with GET and return text (truncated). Read-only.

name: http_request
description: Send an HTTP request (method, url, optional json body) to an app's API. Non-GET needs approval.

name: launch_app
description: Start a registered app (jan, browseros, gimp, obs, audacity, localai, needle...). Needs human approval.

name: stop_app
description: Stop a running registered app. Needs human approval.

name: run_shell
description: Run a shell command on the laptop. Needs human approval. Prefer other tools first.

name: ask_user
description: Ask the human a clarifying question. The answer arrives as tool output.

name: browser_open
description: Open a URL in the tower's browser (headed — the human watches). Returns the final url, title and load time. Payment/trading sites refused.

name: browser_read
description: Read the current page: plain text, title, url and top links. Call after browser_open.

name: browser_click
description: Click a link or button on the current page by css selector OR its visible text (e.g. 'Next' or '#submit').

name: browser_type
description: Type text into a field (selector or placeholder text). Does NOT submit.

name: browser_back
description: Go back in browser history.

name: browser_shot
description: Screenshot the current page. Returns a /static/shots/… url to show the human.

name: browser_submit
description: Submit the form currently focused (press Enter). Creates a server-side effect — needs human approval.

name: browser_tabs
description: List the browser's open tabs with their urls.
